snippet.title: The Empress: Awakening [Official Trailer]
snippet.description:
The Empress: Awakening 
is a fantasy 3rd person hack n slash game inspired by ancient Middle Eastern mythology 

Brief Description

Venture with our hero to the mystic isles of the old gods "Ba'als" and beat the courses to prove that you are worthy ,meet a different types of enemies ,overcome ancient obstacles ,and defeat the usurper witch and free the people from her rule

the game is developed by one person "Zafer Khatib" using unreal engine 4 on a low end laptop 

you can get it now 

https://outer-paradise.itch.io/the-empress-awakening

fb page 
https://www.facebook.com/OuterParadiseGames/
